notes: Unreal Engine Core exports a module calls through its import table, matched by library and mangled name. Windows x64 convention (args RCX, RDX, R8, R9; result RAX); register offsets as in crt_win64.json. Every entry is a declared assumption.

entries.name: FMemory::Malloc
entries.notes: FMemory::Malloc(Count, Alignment): a new block's address (fresh); the allocator's own state is not this module's memory. Internal contract (library-internal-model-cuts): this is the complete observable effect also for callers inside Core; its private state is observed by no code using the model.

entries.name: FMemory::Free
entries.notes: FMemory::Free(Original): assumes no use after free. Internal contract (library-internal-model-cuts): this is the complete observable effect also for callers inside Core; its private state is observed by no code using the model.

entries.name: FMemory::QuantizeSize
entries.notes: FMemory::QuantizeSize(Count, Alignment): a size computed from its arguments; reads no memory. Internal contract (library-internal-model-cuts): this is the complete observable effect also for callers inside Core; its private state is observed by no code using the model.

entries.name: FMemory::Realloc
entries.notes: FMemory::Realloc(Original, Count, Alignment): returns a block holding the old contents: the same object as Original, assuming Original is not used afterwards (no-use-of-old-pointer-after-realloc); Realloc(nullptr, ...) is a fresh block. Internal contract (library-internal-model-cuts): this is the complete observable effect also for callers inside Core; its private state is observed by no code using the model.

entries.name: FDebug::CheckVerifyFailedImpl

Writes no memory of this module -- assumes no reentrant callback into the module (error delegates, log devices): ue-core-diagnostics-no-reentrant-callback. Internal contract (library-internal-model-cuts): this is the complete observable effect also for callers inside Core; its private state is observed by no code using the model.
